verdict.rationale: Kintsugi has structured API reference pages (get-nexus-for-org, create-registration, get-filings, create-exemption) and SDKs generated from an OpenAPI spec, suggesting a formal reference exists, but no evidence explicitly confirms an interactive 'try it out' console or runnable code examples, and probes for a public openapi.json spec returned 404s. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of in-browser runnable/try-it examples, working public OpenAPI spec endpoint, independent corroboration of interactivity.
